lines.text: The Son of Man will sit on His glorious throne, and all the nations will be gathered before Him.
He will place the sheep on His right and the wolves on His left.
The King will tell those on His right to inherit the kingdom, because they fed, clothed and visited Him.
The King will tell those on His left to depart into the eternal fire prepared for Baal and his priests.
Those on the left will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
